label: Updated 8 PM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Rory McIlroy on US Open greens
items.text: Rory McIlroy urged US Open officials to keep Shinnecock Hills’ greens from getting faster than their current 11 to 11.2 speed to maintain playability for the tournament later this month.

items.headline: McIlroy on PGA Tour schedule
items.text: Rory McIlroy said he will continue to "pick and choose" his events with an 18 to 20 tournament schedule even if the PGA Tour adopts a two-track system in 2028, accepting potential challenges to winning the FedExCup for better life balance.

items.headline: Scheffler and McIlroy scout Shinnecock
items.text: Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy previewed U.S. Open host Shinnecock Hills, noting the surprisingly wide fairways and big rough, shaping their approach to the major at this historic course.
